Application Data.NAME: TeleCom Services Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TeleCom Services Inc. specializes in providing comprehensive answering and telemarketing services to businesses across various industries. Our operations include inbound and outbound call management, customer support, lead generation, and appointment scheduling. We employ a team of trained professionals who utilize advanced telephony systems and CRM software to ensure optimal client engagement and satisfaction. Our focus is on maintaining high-quality service standards while adhering to all industry regulations and best practices.
